summary: FASE 3.4 certificate-number format revision (AZR-GEM-000001-YY) tested end-to-end. Created a new unit+E2E suite (test_fase3_4_number_format.py, 16 tests) and updated the OLD FASE 3.1 and 3.3 suites to the new format. All 44 backend tests pass. Frontend verification form uses new placeholder, rejects old format client-side, accepts new format. Counter atomicity verified with 20 concurrent calls (no duplicates); reissue does NOT re-increment the counter. PDF/preview/list/DB/manual+QR verify all show 'AZR-GEM-000015-26' with zero occurrences of the OLD 'AZR-GEM-2026-' anywhere in generated artefacts. Final state clean: certificates=0, gemstones=0, counters.certificate:{year=2026}.last_number=14, next real number will be AZR-GEM-000015-26.

issues: /app/frontend/src/data/sampleGemstones.ts still uses OLD-format certNumber values (AZR-GEM-2026-000101..106). Not consumed by any backend path (display-only sample gems on CatalogPage), but user-visible inconsistency vs. FASE 3.4. Recommend updating to new format like AZR-GEM-000101-26 for consistency.

action_items: Optional: update /app/frontend/src/data/sampleGemstones.ts certNumber fields to new AZR-GEM-000001-26 format so the public Katalog page shows the client-approved format everywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: counter.py new format is clean, atomic ($inc + upsert + ReturnDocument.AFTER); year %100 is safe for 2-digit suffix.
verify.py CERT_RE tightened to ^AZR-GEM-\d{6}-\d{2}$ — old-format numbers correctly generic 'not_found' without record probing.
sampleGemstones.ts (frontend) still holds old-format literal strings; not a business bug but violates the 'no OLD format anywhere visible' rule (minor).
GET /api/admin/certificates/{uuid} detail endpoint does NOT exist (only list + pdf); this was a false assumption in my initial test — noted for future testers.
test_fase3_certificates.py had stale CERT_RE (r'^AZR-GEM-\d{4}-\d{6}$'); updated to new format for future regression.
